en: Yesterday: eight balls, one a bit heavier, and only two tries on the scale.
First, put three balls on each side, and keep the last two balls off the scale.
If the scale stays level, the heavy ball is one of those two. Put them on the scale, one against one.
If one side goes down, take those three balls, and put one ball on each side.
Level again? Then it is the third ball! Found it, in just two tries!
Person one finds a snail, at the bottom of a well, ten metres deep.
Every day, the snail climbs up three metres.
But every night, while it sleeps, it slides back down two metres.
On which day does the snail finally get out of the well?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
